description.narrative: The project seeks to improve transparency and accountability of public service delivery in tax and land record administration in Bangladesh with the help of information and communication technology (ICT). Three outputs of the project are (i) online filing of tax returns, (ii) digitized land records management system in selected districts, and (iii) improved access to tax and land information in specialized information and service centers.

description.narrative: Improved transparency and accountability in tax and land record administrations

The score in global integrity report on the effectiveness of the tax collection authority improves by two points (end of 2008 baseline: 88) Progress/Status: Global Integrity Report for Bangladesh is not available after 2010 and the project's major outputs were completed in 2016. But in other integrity and anti-corruption index, Bangladesh's score has improved, such as in TI's CPI index improved from 4 in 2005 to 27 (out of 100) in 2017. Data Source: NBR annual report Actual value:

A system of risk-based audit for income tax is in place (mid-2010 baseline: no risk-based audits) Progress/Status: Introduction of risk based audit implemented along with establishment of of Bangladesh Integrated Tax Administration System (BITAX), also called the e-filing of tax return system, in 2016. Data Source: Global integrity report Base year: 2010 Baseline value: N

The score in global integrity report on public access to information improves from very weak to weak (end of 2008 baseline: very weak) Progress/Status: Global Integrity Report for Bangladesh is not available after 2010; score improved to 69 in 2010 from 32 in 2008 in this category. But main project outputs were completed in 2016. Score improved in other similar indexes of other think tanks. Data Source: Global integrity report Base year: 2008 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Improved access to tax and land information in specialized information and service centers Indicator: Operationalize 40 information and service centers (2010 baseline: no information center) Progress/Status: 20 Land Information and Service Centers (LISC) under DLRS has been operationalized in Q4 2016. NBR has declared all tax circles as service centers. Data Source: Annual State of Governance in Bangladesh report
Transparency International Bangladesh, April 2005 Actual value:

Output: Digitized land records management system in selected districts Indicator: Complete digitized database on land records in all the five pilot districts (45 upazilas [subdistricts], mid-2010 baseline: only in one upazila) Progress/Status: Complete digitized database on land records in 7 (seven) districts HQs and 45 upazilas [sub-districts] have been completed by June 2017. Data Source: DLRS annual reports
Actual value:
